# oneSOURCE Docs

> > Comprehensive medical device documentation and regulatory compliance platform serving healthcare facilities with IFU, biomedical service manuals, and accreditation standards.

oneSOURCE provides healthcare organizations with centralized access to Instructions For Use (IFU), biomedical equipment documentation, and regulatory compliance resources. Founded by Jack Speer, Dean Crawford, and Lory Hunter, the platform integrates with major healthcare systems and partners like ECRI and Accruent Connectiv to support Joint Commission, CMS, and OSHA compliance requirements.

## Key Topics

- Instructions For Use (IFU)
- Medical Device Compliance
- Regulatory Compliance
- OSHA Safety Data Sheets (SDS/MSDS)
- Biomedical Equipment Documentation
- Hospital Accreditation Standards
- Dental Sterilization Protocols
- HTM Service Manuals
- Joint Commission Compliance
- CMS Requirements
- AAAHC Standards
- Preventive Maintenance
- Surgical Instruments
- Patient Safety
- Healthcare Documentation Management

## Core Products & Solutions

- [IFU | Instructions For Use | Medical & Dental](https://www.onesourcedocs.com/products-solutions/ifu): Instructions For Use documents for surgical instruments, medical devices, and implantable biologics.
- [IFU Product Page](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/ifu): IFU product page for surgical instruments, medical devices, and dental compliance.
- [Biomedical Service Manuals](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/biomed): Biomedical service manuals and preventive maintenance documentation for healthcare equipment.
- [Dental Database Management System](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/dental): Dental library with sterilization protocols, SDS sheets, and OSHA compliance documentation.
- [SDS/MSDS Database](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/sds-database): Safety Data Sheets and MSDS database for OSHA hazardous chemical compliance.
- [Facilities Maintenance Documentation](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/facilities-maintenance): Non-medical systems maintenance documentation for Joint Commission and CMS compliance.
- [World's Most Complete Databases](https://onesourcedocs.com/about-us/worlds-most-complete-databases): oneSOURCE Complete database featuring comprehensive IFU and regulatory compliance documentation.

## Regulatory Compliance & Standards

- [Accreditation Standards](https://onesourcedocs.com/knowledge-center/accreditation-standards): Accreditation standards from CMS, Joint Commission, and AAAHC for regulatory compliance.
- [Manufacturers - Safer-Together Initiative](https://onesourcedocs.com/manufacturers): Manufacturer partner program and safer-together initiative for medical device compliance.

## Integrations & Partnerships

- [Partners](https://onesourcedocs.com/partners): Integration partners including ECRI, Accruent Connectiv for device tracking and alerts.
- [System Interfaces](https://onesourcedocs.com/products/interfaces): CMMS integrations with AIMS, HEMS/EQ2, and MaintenanceFirst systems.
